name: Hemingway Editor
tagline: Highlights long sentences, passive voice and weak phrases to make your writing bold and clear.
about: Hemingway Editor marks hard-to-read sentences in colour and gives a readability grade. A paid version adds AI rewriting.
pros: Colour-coded highlights make problems easy to see.
A readability grade shows how hard the text is.
cons: Rules are rigid; not every flagged sentence needs changing.
AI rewriting needs the paid plan.
